name: Internet Is Beautiful (weekly newsletter of interesting websites)

pitch:
Subject: a tiny site that prints your scrolling as a receipt

Hi,

Submitting one for the newsletter: Doomscroll Receipt turns 'how long I scroll per day' into a printed receipt (per year, per decade, what a 30-minute cut gives back, plus a slightly rude tier name). No account, no ads, no app; the share image is drawn on the reader's device.

https://furiadelimon.github.io/worth-one/drops/doomscroll-receipt/?src=internetisbeautiful

Context: it's the first 'drop' of Worth One?, an independent experiment where one person tries to buy a car by giving away free tools and asking 'was this worth 1 EUR?' afterwards (no payments open, intent only, all public). The tool stands on its own if the story is too odd.

Thanks for the newsletter,
Worth One?
